cross_component_finding: Confirms, from this page's own side, the sharesOptionSetWith finding recorded in this round's child-field-options-reference.json: the Dimension, Similarity Metric, and Optimized For (Vector Fields Only) rows here are word-for-word identical to the same three rows on that page, and the Synonym Source (Text Fields Only) row is near-identical (Couchbase Server 8.0 gate, same synonym-source concept, differing only in which '-quick' vs. non-'-quick' synonym sub-pages it links to). The two pages describe ONE options surface exposed through the Quick Editor path (this page, paired with create-quick-index.md) and the full mapping-editor path (child-field-options-reference.md, paired with create-child-field.md) - not two disconnected option catalogs, per the round briefing's framing.
